intent: A grand Chinese fantasy drama frame from a steep high oblique camera on the upper gallery, looking down across a vast terraced palace courtyard during an interrupted imperial ceremony. The viewer notices a lone arrival splitting the rigid social order.

scene.summary: Rich vermilion timber pavilions, gilded roof corners and broad pale stone terraces arranged in an original asymmetrical plan around a long rectangular reflecting pool. Dense but ordered rows of courtiers in deep plum, petrol blue, gold-bordered ivory and wine-red brocade face the far dais. A lone mud-stained messenger in plain gray stands in the empty central aisle with a collapsed wet banner at his feet; nearest courtiers turn toward him while distant rows still face the dais. Camera height about three stories, 35mm equivalent, downward diagonal rather than straight flat plan; a blurred roof corner intrudes near foreground. Late afternoon ivory light defines warm gold roofs and blue-green arcade shadows. Real human scale, detailed stone joints and selectively intricate costume borders, measured grandeur. Freeze the breath after the messenger enters; the ruler stays small and partly hidden by canopy.
